verdict.rationale: Docs say Bugbot reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions, and teams can tune reviews with BUGBOT.md rules and auto-learned rules. Cursor reports an 80% resolution rate, and one community user says almost none of its comments are frivolous or wrong. However, another hands-on user saw it reissue the same recommendation after they had reverted its own fix, and a team turned off automatic reviews because the agent comments were verbose. Missing for 10: any evidence of severity labels on findings, independent verification that deduplication works reliably, and quantified false-positive rates.
